name: Victoria Jackson
source:
Victoria Jackson is the younger of the two daughters of Coach [url=/c176657]Sam "Glass Jaw" Jackson[/url]. She was only 7 when her mother ran away with Sam's manager. This event has left her with some pretty serious abandonment issues, which, combined with her fiery personality, can at times be pretty scary. She spends almost all her free time at the gym, which tends to take some of the edge off. Victoria is impulsive, impatient, and generous, but her abandonment issues have her fear rejection and avoid intimacy.

[Edited from in-game description]
